resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com date the tower to 1934. The Forest Lookouts history dates completion to 1932 and says the 1934 date, repeated in a 1959 report, is incorrect. The story gives both dates and says so.
60 feet per the register, firelookout.com and the 1932 plan. 72 feet per the completion note on Forest Lookouts (with a question mark) and the Lake County Fire Lookouts blog. The story reports both.
Removed in 1976 per the register and Forest Lookouts; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1976. Both agree the tower is gone.

notes_for_editor: Brief's 'Aermotor' design is supported by Forest Lookouts and the Lake County blog; the register does not name a make. Main unresolved conflicts: build year (1932 vs 1934) and height (60 vs 72 ft). Removed vs destroyed in 1976 is also reported as a conflict. The brief's access 'unknown' is kept out of facts because no source states access. The NGS survey mark is recorded close to the lookout's living quarters; whether it still exists is not verified. One search used.
